C1_gw170817.reading: A light-only optical term can supply at most ~1e-12 of the needed deflection. Lensing 'dark matter' must therefore come from the metric that gravitational waves also follow (single metric): the ITT phantom potential, not a photon-only effect.

C2_distance_duality.model: D_L = (1+z) D_M (1+z)^eps; M (SN) and r_d (BAO) free; flat-LCDM shape for D_M
C2_distance_duality.reading: Any optical effect that brightens or dims distant sources relative to the geometric (BAO) distance is bounded at this level out to z ~ 2.3.

C4_141_99_provenance.source: Arrabal Haro et al. 2023, Nature 622, 707 (arXiv:2303.15431): 'another candidate with suggested z~16 instead has z = 4.9'
C4_141_99_provenance.reading: The 141.99 'boost' was traced (project_god_theory_141) to this object's apparent mass excess at z ~ 16.7. At z = 4.9 that excess does not exist. The factor has no surviving empirical anchor.
